findings.evidence: Mathlib marks every analogous bridge `@[simp]`: `HopfAlgebra/Basic.lean:145` `antipode_eq_id := rfl`, `HopfAlgebra/TensorProduct.lean:53` `antipode_def := rfl`, `HopfAlgebra/Quotient.lean:104` `antipode_mk`, `HopfAlgebra/MonoidAlgebra.lean:45` `antipode_single`; in-repo `TauCeti/Algebra/HopfAlgebra/SymmetricAlgebra/Basic.lean:80` `@[simp] antipode_ι` does the same right after its Hopf instance. The instance body is unexposed, so nothing else lets simp see through `HopfAlgebra.antipode`.
findings.issue: `hopfAlgebraStructAntipode_eq_antipode` is not `@[simp]`, so `HopfAlgebra.antipode R (A := U)` never rewrites to `TauCeti.UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.antipode R` and none of the existing `@[simp]` antipode lemmas (`antipode_mkAlgHom_ι`, `antipode_one`, `antipode_algebraMap`, `antipode_mul_antidistrib`, `antipode_antipode`) fire for consumers of the new Hopf instance — the Kostant Hopf-subring work this PR exists to enable.

findings.evidence: `Mathlib/RingTheory/HopfAlgebra/Basic.lean:121` `@[simp] lemma counit_antipode (a : A) : counit (R := R) (antipode R a) = counit a`; `Antipode.lean` does not import `Bialgebra.lean` and declares no counit lemma (grep of its declarations shows only antipode/antipodeOp/antipodeEquiv/antipodeComap material).
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] theorem counit_antipode (a : U) : Coalgebra.counit (R := R) (antipode R a) = Coalgebra.counit (R := R) a`, one line from `HopfAlgebra.counit_antipode` plus `hopfAlgebraStructAntipode_eq_antipode`.
findings.issue: This is the first module where the antipode and the bialgebra operations are both in scope, yet it states no interaction lemma. Mathlib's `@[simp] HopfAlgebra.counit_antipode` is keyed on head `HopfAlgebra.antipode`, so once the bridge above rewrites a term to `TauCeti.…antipode`, `Coalgebra.counit (antipode R a)` is stuck with no lemma in either form.

summary: The surface is minimal and helper-private with no compatibility artifacts, but the sole bridge lemma linking Mathlib's `HopfAlgebra.antipode` to the existing universal-enveloping antipode is unannotated, leaving the whole antipode simp set unreachable through the Hopf interface, and the module supplies no antipode/bialgebra interaction lemma.
